The proof is `(λ p → g-inj p) , (λ p → Func.cong (proj₁ g) p)`. `_≑_` means each congruence is contained in the other, so it needs two parts:
- **`kercon (⊙-hom f g)` inside `kercon f`:** if `g (f x) ≈ g (f y)`, then `f x ≈ f y` because `g` is injective (`g-inj`).
